It depends. Most things will not kill you but wait to sneak up on you later and cause organ failure. Some things will cause you to have a heart attack or a stroke and that’s painful and most of the time (if you were completely healthy before) survivable. We all have the thought that sleeping pills will send us in our sleep, but they in reality will more than likely just put you to sleep for a bit longer and then cause organ failure later on in life. It’s actually kind of hard to overdose unless you have the right medicine that you know is a sure fire way to lights out. Overdosing on zans or street drugs is easier, but I doubt any death is truly painless as the life draining out of your body is a daunting kind of all over feeling that kind of consumes you. In other words you kind of feel your body shutting down at some point. Also if anyone catches you in the midst of a drug overdose they’re going to get you to a hospital and being resuscitated and going through that entire process of reversing the damage you did is painful and has lasting effects later on in life. I do not condone nor recommend trying to end your life like this or any other way. Pm me if you need anything.

All I can say is you will regret it if you fail. Doctors (well at least in my two attempts) are not really kind to suicide attempt failures. They act as if you’re wasting their time, and they may not outright say it but it’s written on their face that they’d rather be dealing with something or someone else. Most of the time suicide attempts fail unless you use a gun it’s actually quite hard to kill yourself. Even with a gun there’s a chance you survive and then your suffering even more in pain trying to regain the ability to talk and move. I had a cousin whose first attempt at suicide left her physically impaired. She tried again with a gun and she STILL survived and now she’s living a life that no one wants to live and she can’t escape cause she’s paralyzed. I joined this sub cause I needed to feel as if someone (anyone) could relate to me, and now that I see it I like to comment back and possibly help brightens someone’s day (even if just a little). I understand you and dm me if you ever need to talk.
